name: Dumbbell Bench Press
tips: Elbows at about 45° from your body
Shoulder blades squeezed back and down
Lower under control to chest level

name: Barbell Overhead Press
tips: Brace glutes and abs before every rep
Keep the bar path close to your face
At the top, push your head through and pause briefly

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
tips: Bench at 30–45°
Control the descent, press up and slightly in

name: Cable Fly
tips: Slight, fixed bend in the elbows
Bring hands together at chest height and squeeze

name: Lateral Raise
tips: Raise both arms together, slightly forward of your body
Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height
Keep a slight bend in the elbows

name: Skull Crusher
tips: Upper arms stay still, pointing slightly back
Lower the bar toward your forehead under control

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
tips: Elbows pinned to your sides
Spread the rope apart at the bottom

name: Pull Ups
tips: Retract your shoulder blades first, then pull
Full dead hang at the bottom
No kipping

name: Barbell Row
tips: Hands shoulder-width apart
Hinge at the hips with a flat back
Lift the bar to knee height, then row it to your navel
Use an overhand grip for 2 sets and an underhand grip for 2

name: Lat Pulldown
tips: Lean back slightly
Drive the elbows down toward your hips

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
tips: Sets are per arm
Brace on a bench with a flat back
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip

name: Face Pulls
tips: Rope at upper-chest height or higher
Pull toward your forehead with hands apart
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the end

name: EZ-Bar Curl
tips: Elbows stay at your sides
No swinging — control the way down

name: Hammer Curl
tips: Alternate arms
Neutral grip, thumbs up

name: Smith Machine Squat
tips: Feet slightly in front of the bar
Brace, then sit down between your hips
Drive up through the whole foot

name: Romanian Deadlift
tips: Soft knees, push the hips back
Bar stays close to your legs
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
tips: Sets are per leg
Rear foot on the bench, front shin roughly vertical
Lower straight down under control

name: Leg Curl
tips: Pause briefly at full contraction
Control the way back

name: Leg Extension
tips: Pause at the top
Don't let the weight stack slam

name: Standing Calf Raise
tips: Put two plates under the balls of your feet for a full stretch
Pause at the bottom and at the top

name: Running
tips: Start the first kilometer easy
Relaxed shoulders, quick light steps

name: Walking
tips: Brisk, comfortable pace
Good excuse to get outside

name: Freestyle — Easy
tips: Relaxed, long strokes
Focus on exhaling fully underwater

name: Freestyle — Main Set
tips: 10 × 100 m at a steady, strong pace
Rest ~20 s at the wall between repeats
Breathe every 3 strokes if you can

name: Crunches
tips: Lift the shoulder blades, not the neck
Exhale on the way up

name: Bicycle Crunches
tips: Elbow toward the opposite knee
Slow and controlled beats fast

name: Lying Leg Raises
tips: Lower back pressed into the floor
Lower the legs slowly

name: Russian Twists
tips: Lean back with a straight spine
Rotate from the torso, not just the arms

name: Mountain Climbers
tips: Hips level with the shoulders
Drive the knees toward the chest

name: Dead Bug
tips: Lower back stays on the floor
Opposite arm and leg move together

name: Plank
tips: Squeeze glutes and abs
Straight line from head to heels

name: Side Plank
tips: Set 1 left side, set 2 right side
Hips high, body in one line

name: Hollow Body Hold
tips: Lower back glued to the floor
Bend the knees to make it easier

name: Cat-Cow
tips: Move slowly with your breath
Round and arch through the whole spine

name: World's Greatest Stretch
tips: Set 1 left side, set 2 right side
Lunge, elbow to instep, then rotate and reach up

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
tips: Set 1 left side, set 2 right side
Squeeze the glute of the back leg
Tuck the pelvis — don't arch the lower back

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
tips: Sit tall
Rotate both knees side to side slowly

name: Open Book Rotation
tips: Set 1 left side, set 2 right side
Lie on your side, knees stacked
Open the top arm and follow it with your eyes

name: Downward Dog to Cobra
tips: Flow slowly between the two positions
Press the heels toward the floor in down dog

name: Standing Forward Fold
tips: Soft knees, let the head hang
Breathe into the stretch

name: Deep Squat Hold
tips: Heels down, chest up
Push the knees out with the elbows
